detection_floors.question: By how much would a better nominal predictor lower the magnitude at which a fault becomes visible to the temporal sub-score?
detection_floors.structural_finding: A channel with NO STIMULUS at any magnitude is not a detection failure. It means the fault does not perturb that channel at all, so no predictor of any kind could see it and reporting a floor would be reporting an instrument artifact as a result.

controls.basis: the first difference of a linear ramp is a constant, so a model fitted on differences predicts it exactly while persistence carries the full step every sample; this is arithmetic, not a property of this tool
controls.control: a differencing model tracks a pure ramp and persistence does not

controls.basis: independent samples carry no predictable component; the sqrt(2) allowed here is the known ratio between a difference of two independent draws and one draw, not a tolerance chosen for this study
controls.control: a fitted model does not beat persistence on white noise

instrument_controls.does_not_establish: that the instrument's other measurements are correct. A control pair shows it still responds to a known stimulus and stays silent on a null one -- it is a liveness and discrimination check, not a calibration.

design.metric: d_prime = (mean|innovation| in the fault window on the FAULTED flight - mean|innovation| in the SAME window on the CLEAN flight) / std of that clean window. Paired on window, profile and seed, so flight phase cannot be read as a fault.
design.test: fast_cruise, seed offset 100 -- a different profile AND a different noise realisation

whiteness_vs_detection.question: Would a better nominal predictor let the existing lam machinery detect smaller faults?
whiteness_vs_detection.what_this_is_not: Every fault here is a parametric injection from six known kinds, so a predictor scored against them is scored against the injector. The repository records fault classes the simulator cannot produce at all, and those are the regimes a better predictor would be claimed to help with. A positive result here is a reason to collect real data, not a reason to ship a model. Nothing in CSIA was changed to produce it.
